broadenings.add: integrated signal intensity over an image region of interest (IVIS radiance, fluorescence-probe intensity in CLSM or plate reads) converted into a relative amount of the labelled species
broadenings.why: Bioactive o3->o4: tumour-ROI fluorescence is integrated from the IVIS maps into a bar chart that stands for NP accumulation. The act is intensity -> amount, as for peak areas; the audits are shared (saturation, background, attenuation with depth). measure_feature_metric (sizes, counts) does not fit. Becomes via=image_intensity if Q1 is merged.

broadenings.add: permit it on a derives edge when a colocalization coefficient (Pearson, Manders) or a ratio of counts across two registered channels of the same field is computed
broadenings.why: Bioactive o9->o10 (Pearson R from TRFC and MitoTracker channels) and PVA-hydrogel r2 (viable fraction = CMFDA-fluorescent count over total count in the matched phase-contrast field). The act that can fail is registration (channel bleed-through, misalignment, thresholds), not the arithmetic. The r03 rule 'derives ops must be transform/quantify' would force measure_feature_metric, which hides the two-view dependency. Alternative: state in the rule that register_colocated_views is the one compare op allowed on derives.

broadenings.add: a note (or a value 'photochemical') for light-triggered generation or release of species by the material: photosensitized ROS, NO release from a donor, photo-uncaging
broadenings.why: Bioactive b10 is the property that the whole argument hangs on, yet none of the 12 families fits; 'catalytic' implies turnover, 'biological' only holds because it was read in cells. Recurs in PDT/PTT, photocatalysis side-products and photoresponsive drug release. Attr-level only; no type change.

broadenings.add: remove 'defect concentration' from PRP/descriptor; vacancy/defect concentration claims are STR/defect/point (attrs.aspect=concentration); descriptor keeps carrier density, mobility, effective mass, diffusivity
broadenings.why: JAC j11 (oxide-ion vacancy concentration highest at x = 0.175, argued from band gap) fits both definitions verbatim. The next inference (carrier/diffusion argument) is point-defect's own, so the overlap is spurious.

merges.why: C1. usage track [17,9], compare [98,26]. In r04 I used track three times on stacked traces (JAC s1: BiVO4 reflection through x and heat-treatment stages; s6: DSC beta->gamma endotherm 445 -> 421 -> ~400 C -> absent; s3: main reflection shift). In every case the dst OBS type (feature_presence / feature_shift) already says a single identified feature is followed, and the identity risk (is the shallow 400 C dip the same transition?) belongs to the upstream assignment, not to the compare act. Nothing is lost by retyping these to compare_across_conditions. Keep track_ only for object identity across frames (none in my papers).

Q1. usage [8,6] + [2,2] + [5,2]. In r04 `via` was unambiguous in both cases (JAC s4->s5 Rietveld positions -> c; Bioactive o3->o4 image ROI intensity -> accumulation). Merging also absorbs my image-intensity broadening without widening a leaf. Audits differ only by which relation is trusted, which via records.

Q2. usage [7,6] + [4,3]. JAC uses three forms on one paper: Arrhenius slope (s10->s12), Tauc intercept (s8), equivalent-circuit fit (s15->s13). They share one failure mode, choice of the fitted window (the F5 Tauc lines are drawn over different ranges per sample). The diagnostic chain is carried by PRP/diagnostic (j14 -> KNW j21 -> MEC/identification j15), not by the op name, so P2 should stay while Q2 merges.

O2. usage [3,3]. JAC's partition claim (j16, Rg > Rgb) is evidenced by a fitted_parameter from an equivalent circuit, not by a coplotted total/component figure, so the OBS leaf is not what makes the partition inference visible. BUT keep PRP/partition (reject P1): j16 is the only node that shows that the paper's own impedance data undercut its grain-growth branch (j16 qualifies j12). As PRP/value(aspect=partition) that qualifier would read as one more value.

O1. usage [1,1]. JAC is a phase-stability paper (phase vs composition and temperature via XRD, DSC, Arrhenius breaks) and still needed no regime map: stability windows were read as feature_presence along one variable.
K1. usage [1,1] each; neither needed in 4 r04 papers with ~40 figure edges.

indistinguishable_siblings.note: In drug-loaded microspheres both are read from the same CLSM contrast (bright = BSA, dark = void): 'large internal pores' and 'non-uniform BSA' are one observation. Suggested boundary: when the constituent is the pore filler, type porosity and record distribution in attrs; not a merge (the two differ elsewhere).

For fluorescence images whose brightness stands for amount and location (IVIS, probe CLSM, colocalization) I could not decide consistently; I typed o5 appearance and o3/o9 distribution. A note in the definitions ('where a labelled species is' = distribution; 'whether the signal is there' = appearance) would do.
In-vitro release at the intended use temperature (22 C) is both the property and the service test. I split rate (PRP) from argued suitability (PRF, basis argued).
For molecularly designed chimeras (four-domain peptide) the 'base' is an arbitrary choice among domains. Workable, but the split carries no inference here.

comments: No new types, rels, mm_ops or modalities: 131 nodes over 4 papers all typed with v03, 1 poor fit (Bioactive b10, property_family only). Contentious points. (1) C1 merge: I support it on evidence from stacked XRD and DSC traces; identity risk sits in assignment, not in the compare act. (2) P1 vs O2: merge the OBS leaf, keep PRP/partition; in JAC it is the only visible carrier of an internal contradiction (grain-interior-dominated resistance vs claimed grain-growth benefit). (3) P2: keep PRP/diagnostic; the Arrhenius regime -> order-disorder identification in JAC runs through it. (4) The r03 rule 'derives ops must be transform/quantify' needs one exception for colocalization computed from registered channels (Bioactive o9->o10); otherwise registration errors become invisible. (5) Never-needed list reflects my biomedical/ceramic mix; low use of STR/defect/extended and damage is corpus mix (as the judge said), not redundancy, so I do not propose merging them. Packet anomalies: Biomaterials (02)00177-1 F3 image shows paper Fig. 4 (CMFDA + phase contrast) while its caption concatenates Fig. 3 (EDAC scheme) and Fig. 4; F2 has only the label 'Photoactive PVA with RGDS'. Biomaterials (00)00178-2 F2 caption says panel B = 0.1% PVA, text says 0.5%. Figure-text conflicts recorded: JAC F5 shows all doped band gaps below parent while text says blue shift (s9); JAC F1d main reflection moves to higher 2theta, not obviously consistent with the claimed c expansion (s3, text-silent); Bioactive F4b plotted Pearson max ~0.77 vs text 0.79; microsphere F10 burst ~20% at day 2, not the >50% in the MatMech extraction.
